> Remix of “ToonHead” by Johan Melin, licensed under CC BY 4.0.

## Modifications in Sports Face MVP

- Curated and neutralised subset of the original component variants.
- Recolouring from FaceDNA palettes.
- Sports-shirt overlays and kit colours.
- Morphological scaling of the face group.
- Additional nose, glasses, freckles, scars and ageing details.
- Simplified bun geometry for this temporary prototype.
- Original sports hair, beard and shirt overlays.
- Visual suppression of strong premature grey and age-based beard caps.

The ToonHead-derived vector data is kept in `src/toon-head-assets.js` and is
licensed under CC BY 4.0. Application code remains under its stated license.
This package is an internal technical prototype; obtain legal review before a
commercial distribution that combines differently licensed materials.
